excerpts.content:
Hi everyone,

This channel is dedicated to the transition of the execution layer toward post-quantum cryptography. The primary EIP currently relevant to this—which is due for discussion—is EIP-8288: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/master/EIPS/eip-8288.md

Given the vast scope of what it encompasses, the proposal is to split it into three separate EIPs:

- leanSPHINCS: covers the post-quantum hash-based signature scheme intended to replace ECDSA.

- leanPCS: covers the polynomial commitment scheme (PCS) that we plan to expose, which will allow for the aggregation of multiple signatures into a single proof.

- leanMempool: covers everything related to the mempool and the necessary networking adaptations to ensure everything functions correctly in a post-quantum environment.

The specification for leanSPHINCS (currently our strongest candidate) can be found here: https://github.com/ethereum/EthLib/tree/master/EthLib/Cryptography/Sphincs
